opening.speaker: oren
opening.text: The evacuation order is signed. They want every house empty before sunset.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: And the people who cannot walk?

opening.speaker: ivo
opening.text: They were not mentioned in the order. I have six patients still on this side of the river.

opening.speaker: sera
opening.text: The patrol is crossing the upper bridge. If we hold the square, the wagons can reach the south road.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: Then that is what this banner means today. A road out. Nothing more.

opening.speaker: oren
opening.text: That will be enough for the people behind us.

closing.speaker: ivo
closing.text: The last wagon is across. All six patients are still complaining, which I take as a good sign.

closing.speaker: lyra
closing.text: Oren, you can go home now.

closing.speaker: oren
closing.text: There is an empty square where my home used to feel safe. I would rather help you change that.

opening.speaker: mara
opening.text: I can carry your people north. I cannot sail through an iron chain.

opening.speaker: tarin
opening.text: The chain is raised from the eastern tollhouse. The guards are protecting a shipment with the royal observatory seal.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: Food? Weapons?

opening.speaker: tarin
opening.text: Sunstone. More than any furnace could safely burn.

opening.speaker: mara
opening.text: Questions after the crossing. Take their flag, and I will take their river.

closing.speaker: mara
closing.text: The river is open. You owe me one chain and a great deal of rope.

closing.speaker: tarin
closing.text: These manifests lead to the abbey furnaces. Whatever the regent is building, he is running out of time.

closing.speaker: lyra
closing.text: Then we go north before he decides to borrow ours.

opening.speaker: nell
opening.text: The children know to follow my lantern. The soldiers know it too.

opening.speaker: bram
opening.text: My horses can pull the last wagon, but the axle will not survive a gallop.

opening.speaker: sera
opening.text: We can hold the bends in the road. The trees will make their archers work for a clear shot.

opening.speaker: ivo
opening.text: Six bells. That is how long we need.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: Keep the lanterns moving. We will keep the road.

closing.speaker: nell
closing.text: Every lantern accounted for. Bram even brought back the broken axle.

closing.speaker: bram
closing.text: Good timber is good timber.

closing.speaker: sera
closing.text: Tomorrow we follow the abbey road. Tonight, let the horses sleep.

opening.speaker: esme
opening.text: They took the bell three mornings ago. Now they make us ring an iron plate for the work shifts.

opening.speaker: rook
opening.text: I helped them seize this abbey. I know the sentries, and I know the man giving the orders.

opening.speaker: oren
opening.text: You expect us to trust you?

opening.speaker: rook
opening.text: No. Put me at the front, where you can see what I do.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: We free the granary and remove the overseer. What comes after that, you will have to earn.

closing.speaker: esme
closing.text: The granary keys were in his desk. He kept the bell’s clapper beside them.

closing.speaker: rook
closing.text: I cannot give back the mornings we took from this place.

closing.speaker: esme
closing.text: No. But you can help us hang another bell.

opening.speaker: cassian
opening.text: Your standard bears my family’s colors.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: It was the only cloth large enough to cover a wagon. You may have it when everyone is safe.

opening.speaker: faye
opening.text: The imperial checkpoint will arrest both of you while you argue over laundry.

opening.speaker: cassian
opening.text: You have a route through the trees?

opening.speaker: faye
opening.text: Two. Neither is wide enough for your pride.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: We take the eastern gate together. The crown can wait.

closing.speaker: cassian
closing.text: I thought people would rally when they saw my crest.

closing.speaker: faye
closing.text: They rallied when you helped push a cart out of the ditch.

closing.speaker: cassian
closing.text: A rather less dignified kind of leadership.

closing.speaker: lyra
closing.text: You may be good at it.

opening.speaker: vela
opening.text: The beacon is still lit, but there are soldiers in every warehouse.

opening.speaker: dax
opening.text: Dock crews are trapped between the occupation and the fires. They will come out when the patrols fall.

opening.speaker: mara
opening.text: My boat is on the far quay. Try not to burn the good rope.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: We clear the harbor street by street. Leave the doors open behind us.

opening.speaker: dax
opening.text: You heard her. Today we unload an army.

closing.speaker: dax
closing.text: Three warehouses, two barges, and everyone we could find. The harbor is ours.

closing.speaker: vela
closing.text: The beacon is clear to the far shore. Someone has answered it.

closing.speaker: mara
closing.text: Then the next tide belongs to us.

opening.speaker: una
opening.text: The embassy was promised safe passage. The promise lasted until we entered the pass.

opening.speaker: silas
opening.text: I have the written order that arranged the ambush. Get it to the cities, and the regent loses his excuses.

opening.speaker: cassian
opening.text: And if we cannot hold the pass?

opening.speaker: una
opening.text: Then take the documents anyway. I am tired of being the reason someone else stays behind.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: Nobody is being traded for a piece of paper. We hold together, then we leave together.

closing.speaker: silas
closing.text: The orders are in the hands of every city council. I have never delivered so many copies of the truth.

closing.speaker: una
closing.text: And the embassy survivors?

closing.speaker: ivo
closing.text: All here. Tired of diplomats asking after them, but here.

opening.speaker: petra
opening.text: I built the west supports. The old maintenance walk still crosses underneath the garrison.

opening.speaker: ari
opening.text: The patrol changes at the eastern gate. I can keep the signal birds above the arches.

opening.speaker: oren
opening.text: Can the aqueduct bear the company?

opening.speaker: petra
opening.text: It bore a city’s water for two hundred years. Walk where I tell you.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: We take the gate and open the sluices. Let the valley have something back.

closing.speaker: petra
closing.text: Listen. That is water reaching the lower channels.

closing.speaker: ari
closing.text: The birds are following it all the way down.

closing.speaker: lyra
closing.text: For once, let the news arrive before the soldiers.

opening.speaker: noor
opening.text: The engine is not making sunlight. It is drawing heat from the land and storing it above the capital.

opening.speaker: tarin
opening.text: That cannot continue. The valley would freeze, then burn when the containment fails.

opening.speaker: galen
opening.text: The roots below my monastery are already warm in winter.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: Can we stop it here?

opening.speaker: noor
opening.text: The observatory controls its aim. Break that control first. Then I can find the anchors.

closing.speaker: noor
closing.text: Three anchors. One in the furnace, two under the palace. We can reach them.

closing.speaker: galen
closing.text: Then I will pack more seeds.

closing.speaker: tarin
closing.text: For a siege?

closing.speaker: galen
closing.text: For the day after. Someone ought to think of it.

opening.speaker: hale
opening.text: I dug these tunnels. They told us the engine would end the hungry winters.

opening.speaker: yuna
opening.text: In the palace they told a different story. They said the workers were honored volunteers.

opening.speaker: hale
opening.text: Then let us show them some honored volunteers walking out.

opening.speaker: ivo
opening.text: The treatment stations are ready at both exits.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: Clear the furnace halls. Nobody stays to fuel this machine.

closing.speaker: hale
closing.text: Nobody left below. I checked the old shafts myself.

closing.speaker: yuna
closing.text: The palace service doors open at dawn. I still remember every step.

closing.speaker: lyra
closing.text: Then we will be there when they open.

opening.speaker: elian
opening.text: My regiment has opened the outer defenses. The inner guard has not answered.

opening.speaker: rhea
opening.text: My father read your offer of surrender. Then he locked the engine chamber.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: Do you still want to go in?

opening.speaker: rhea
opening.text: I want him to open the door. If he will not, I want to be there when we do.

opening.speaker: cassian
opening.text: Then no banners above the gate until this is over. Today we enter as a company.

closing.speaker: elian
closing.text: The guard has stood down. No one outside the chamber is still fighting.

closing.speaker: rhea
closing.text: I can hear him speaking through the door. He is giving orders to an empty room.

closing.speaker: lyra
closing.text: Then we should not leave him there alone.

opening.speaker: noor
opening.text: The anchors are failing. Every order sworn to the crown feeds the binding again.

opening.speaker: rhea
opening.text: He thinks keeping his oath will keep the city alive.

opening.speaker: oren
opening.text: An oath does not mend a broken thing by breaking everyone around it.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: We stop the keeper. We shut down the engine. Then we help whoever is left, on either side.

opening.speaker: ivo
opening.text: I have brought every bandage we own.

opening.speaker: lyra
opening.text: Let us try not to need them all.

closing.speaker: rhea
closing.text: I thought the sky would go dark.

closing.speaker: noor
closing.text: That was only the borrowed light. Morning does not need the engine.

closing.speaker: cassian
closing.text: And the throne?

closing.speaker: lyra
closing.text: We can discuss chairs after we get everyone home.

closing.speaker: oren
closing.text: I know a square with room for a very long table.
